output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls mintToken, the balanceOf target is increased without a check, allowing the totalSupply to be arbitrarily increased, thus transferring balance from 'this' to target.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the sender's balance is checked, if it is less than the value, an overflow occurs, allowing the transfer function to be deactivated.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the sender's balance is checked, if it is less than the value, an overflow occurs, allowing the transferFrom function to be deactivated.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the contract balance is checked, if it is less than the amount, an overflow occurs, allowing the buy function to be deactivated.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the contract tries to send funds, if the sender does not have enough balance, an overflow occurs, allowing the sell function to be deactivated.
